name: agent_summarize
description: Ask one of your delegated children for an on-demand summary of where it stands and WAIT for it. Same mechanism as agent_ask — the request is the child's next turn, the answer is what the child itself sends back quoting the request — but the child sees it as a summary request, not a question. This call BLOCKS until the summary arrives or the budget elapses; on timeout the request is still in the child's inbox. Only your OWN children may be summarized.

focus.description: What the summary should cover — the question the summary must answer for you ("what is blocking you", "which files have you changed and why").

harp.description: The child session harp to summarize (from agent_run's harp, or the roster)

outputSchema.description: One cooperative answer to a question or summarize ask.

ask_id.description: The id the child's reply quoted — the same id its question carried.

from.description: The harp that answered, resolved from the inbox the reply came from, never from anything the reply claimed.

structured.description: The reply's structured companion, when the child attached one.

text.description: The reply body: what the child chose to send.
